title: 第7章 省赛
slug: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
lines: 陈峰依旧盘膝坐在客厅的地板上，感受着体内那股奔涌不息的暖流。
气血如溪，潺潺而动。
这就是突破【气血关】后的感觉。
身躯中的每一处经脉都仿佛活跃起来，气血涌动之下，修行效率比之前高了至少五成。
他正准备起身洗漱睡觉，沙发上的手机屏幕忽然亮了起来。
是一条微信消息，备注名称：柔姐。
【小峰，在吗？】
【你们班导师今天给我打电话了，说你已经连续旷了半个月的课了，是不是出了什么事了？】
陈峰看着屏幕上的文字，顿感有些头疼。
周柔是他邻居家的姐姐。
父母早亡后，陈峰基本就是靠着周柔一家的接济长大的，两人的关系和亲姐弟没什么区别。
周柔大学学的财会，毕业后就进了天衡医药公司做会计。
后来似乎是和老板的女儿处成了闺蜜，一路升迁，日子过的不错。
陈峰之前手头紧的时候，也都是周柔转钱给他。
没想到班导师梁越居然会直接联系到周柔那里去。
陈峰思索片刻，手指在屏幕上敲击起来。
【姐，我没事，就是前段时间身体不太舒服，休息了一阵。】
随后消息秒回。
【身体不舒服？严不严重？去医院看了没？】
【看了看了，小毛病，已经好了。】
【那你明天赶紧去上课，别再旷了，梁老师语气挺严肃的，我听着都替你捏把汗。】
【知道了姐，明天就去。】
【嗯，那你周末过来找我一趟，正好我这边有点事想跟你说。】
【早点睡。】
【好，姐你也早点睡。】
结束聊天。
陈峰将手机丢到一旁，长长吐出一口气。
看来老梁这老小子，是真盯上自己了。
武道学专业的每个班级，都会配备一名班导师，除了教课之外，还负责学生的日常修行和思想工作。
陈峰的班导师就是梁越，一个年近四十的中年男人，平日里对学生尽心尽力，在三班风评极好。
但这对于陈峰来说，可就难受了。
毕竟他眼下可没功夫长时间待在学校里。
“明天估计得挨一顿训。”
陈峰心中暗道。
不过现在的自己，倒也无需太过担忧。
他微微握拳，感受着肌肉深处涌动的力量，心中已然有了打算。
第二天清晨。
陈峰被手机的提示音吵醒。
从床上坐起拿过手机看了一眼，
是白鱼APP的后台消息。
已经有好几个买家发来私信，询问灰伞肺菇的情况，其中一个甚至一口气下了十株的单。
陈峰简单回复了几句，告诉他们下午发货，随后起身检查了一下自己右臂上的伤口。
经过一夜时间已经好的差不多了。
随后他换好衣服，洗漱完毕，背上那个老旧的帆布包出门，在校门口的小吃摊随便啃了两个包子，便走进学校。
今天上午八点的课，正好就是班导师梁越的《标准练气导论》指导课。
陈峰来到B区2栋教学楼，走进三楼的训练室。
训练室中颇为宽敞。
武道三班的学生已经到了大半，三三两两的聚在一起，或是在做热身，或是在闲聊刷手机。
陈峰的出现，立刻吸引了不少人的注意。
只是那些投来的视线，都带着几分古怪。
“陈峰！这儿！”
训练室左侧靠窗的位置，吴志超正冲他招手，旁边还站着舍友林远。
陈峰走了过去。
“我的哥，你可算来了！”
吴志超一脸同情的看着陈峰，压低声音道：
“你完蛋了，刚才老梁来过一趟，专门问你来了没有。”
林远也是一脸无奈：
“看那架势，老梁这次是真火了，待会儿上课，你自求多福吧，估计得当着全班的面削你。”
陈峰点了点头：
“嗯，反正来都来了。”
两人微微一愣，有些面面相觑：
“有一说一，你小子这心理素质倒是真不错。”
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
梁越话落。

    陈峰点了点头，从仪器上走下来，回到角落坐好。

    心里暗暗松了口气。

    有了梁越的默许，接下来他进出大墟的时间就灵活多了，不用再担心学校三天两头查考勤。

    至于其他同学怎么想，那不重要。

    而四周的窃窃私语还在继续。

    毕竟在大一这个阶段，体质能上12的，绝对算班里第一梯队了。

    一个之前成绩中下的人，半个月时间直接跻身尖子行列，搁谁都得嘀咕两句。

    “行了，都安静。”

    梁越拍了拍讲台桌面，声音不大，训练室里却迅速安静下来。

    “准备上课。”

    他扫了一眼底下的学生，顿了一下，又开口：“哦，对了，还有件事，上课之前，提前通知一下。”

    “两个月后，东湖省将举办大一年级武道竞赛。”

    这话一出，底下有人抬起了头。

    “省赛？”

    “大一就能参加省赛了？我之前听学长提过一嘴……”

    梁越抬手往下压了压，没等议论发酵就继续往下说：

    “本次省赛，全省共有三十二所武道院校参赛。其中包括一所武英级院校，三所武重级院校，以及八所一本院校。”

    武英级院校。

    那是整个东湖省武道教育体系中最顶尖的存在，全省仅此一家的——东湖武英大学。

    每年从东湖武英毕业的学生，几乎都能直接进入省级以上的官方机构或顶尖企业。

    而武重级院校，则类似于武英的下一档。

    全省三所，每所都有国家重点扶持的武道研究项目，师资力量和资源配置远超普通一本。

    以陈峰的角度看来，这两类院校有点像是985和211。

    不过考取难度更高，不论国家资源倾斜的程度，还是制度内的权利地位，也都比前世的顶尖院校更大。

    而至于陈峰所在的锦城大学，则只是八所普通一本中的其中一所。

    梁越继续说道：“而且，奖励也不少。”

    “第一，奖金方面，按名次发放，二万到十万不等。”

    “第二，会有学分奖励，直接计入毕业评优总分。”

    底下的议论声逐渐热切起来。

    梁越伸出手指：“第三。”

    “能考进前十名的学生，学校会直接授予三级助理研究生身份。”

    “表现优异者，有机会保研，成为本校的武道研究生。”

    这句话砸下来，整个训练室顿时炸了。

    “保研！？”

    “三级助理研究生？？”

    “我操……”

    七十多号人，人人神色热切，目光炯炯的盯着台上的梁越。

    武道研究生。

    这几个字的份量，在座的人都清楚。

    和陈峰前世记忆中那种给导师当牛马、一个月补贴一两千的研究生惨状完全不同。

    这个时代的武道研究生，含金量高得吓人。

    锦城大学的武道研究生，国家补贴每月超过三万块。

    校内各类研究灵药优先使用，实验室开放使用权限。

    甚至能在校内挂职，参与行政管理和资源调配。
content_en:
Liang Yue finished speaking.

Chen Feng nodded, stepped off the instrument, and returned to the corner to sit down.

I was secretly relieved.

With Liang Yue's acquiescence, his time to enter and leave the market will be much more flexible, and he no longer has to worry about the school checking attendance every three days.

As for what other students think, that doesn't matter.

And the whispers all around continued.

After all, in the freshman year, those with a physical fitness of 12 are definitely considered to be in the first echelon of the class.

A person who had average grades before rose to the top ranks in half a month, and everyone would have to murmur.

"Okay, everyone, be quiet."

Liang Yue patted the tabletop of the podium, his voice was not loud, but the training room quickly became quiet.

"Get ready for class."

He glanced at the students below, paused, and then said: "Oh, by the way, there is one more thing. I need to inform you in advance before going to class."

"In two months, Donghu Province will hold a martial arts competition for first-year students."

As soon as these words came out, someone below raised their head.

"Provincial competition?"

"Can I participate in the provincial competition as a freshman? I heard my senior mention it before..."

Liang Yue raised his hand and pressed it down, and continued to speak before the discussion could ferment:

"In this provincial competition, a total of thirty-two martial arts schools across the province are participating. Among them are one Wuying-level school, three Wushu-level schools, and eight first-level schools."

Wuying-level colleges and universities.

It was the top institution in the martial arts education system in Donghu Province, and the only one in the province - Donghu Wuying University.

Every year, students who graduate from Donghu Wuying can almost directly enter official institutions or top companies at the provincial level or above.

The Wu heavy-level colleges and universities are similar to the next level of Wuying.

There are three schools in the province, each with a martial arts research project supported by the state, and the teaching staff and resource allocation are far beyond those of ordinary schools.

From Chen Feng's perspective, these two types of colleges are a bit like 985 and 211.

However, it is more difficult to pass the exam, and regardless of the degree of national resource tilt, or the power status within the system, it is also greater than the top universities in the previous life.

As for Jincheng University where Chen Feng is located, it is only one of the eight ordinary universities.

Liang Yue continued: "Moreover, there are many rewards."

"First, in terms of bonuses, they are distributed according to ranking, ranging from 20,000 to 100,000."

"Second, there will be credit awards, which will be directly counted into the total graduation evaluation score."

The discussion below gradually became enthusiastic.

Liang Yue stretched out his finger: "Third."

"The school will directly award third-level assistant graduate students to the top ten students."

"Those who perform well will have the opportunity to be admitted to graduate school and become martial arts graduate students of our school."

When these words were spoken, the entire training room exploded.

"Hoken!?"

"Third-level assistant graduate student??"

"Fuck..."

There were more than seventy people, everyone looked eager and stared at Liang Yue on the stage.

Martial arts graduate student.

Everyone here knows the weight of these words.

It is completely different from the miserable situation of graduate students in Chen Feng's previous life who worked as a mentor for his tutor and received a monthly subsidy of one to two thousand.

The gold content of martial arts graduate students in this era is frighteningly high.

The state subsidy for martial arts graduate students at Jincheng University exceeds 30,000 yuan per month.

All kinds of research elixirs in the school are given priority, and the laboratory is open to use.

You can even take a temporary job on campus to participate in administrative management and resource allocation.
